subject: physics
title: Воздушный шар, пункт a
statement:
Consider a hot-air balloon with fixed volume $V_B = 1.1$ m³. The mass of the balloon-envelope, whose volume is to be neglected in comparison to $V_B$, is $m_H = 0.187$ kg. The balloon shall be started, where the external air temperature is $\vartheta_1 = 20$ °C and the normal external air pressure is $p_0 = 1.013 \cdot 10^5$ Pa. Under these conditions the density of air is $\rho_1 = 1.2$ kg/m³.

**Пункт a.** What temperature $\vartheta_2$ must the warmed air inside the balloon have to make the balloon just float? (V_B = 1.1 m³, m_H = 0.187 kg, ρ_1 = 1.2 kg/m³, ϑ_1 = 20 °C)
